summary: Binance Wallet started a Pokémon card gacha (Bronze $28, Silver $48, Gold $88 packs of PSA-graded cards), and KOLs across Thai, Vietnamese and English X are posting their rips. Jupiter showed off Nova pack rips at Breakpoint, and Collector Crypt's vault reportedly hit $70M, even as onchain gacha volume fell 23.2% week over week per @0x_trophy. On the collector side, One Piece players are fed up with Bandai product, and Fanatics Collect gets flak for slow redemptions. Solflare Packs got a wave of small, positive explainer posts, mostly from ambassadors.
